name: Mr.PURE - COLOUR
summary: Mr Pure RO Water Purifier combines RO, UV, UF, and TDS control technology to deliver clean, safe, and great-tasting drinking water.
intro: Mr Pure RO Water Purifier is an advanced RO + UV + UF + TDS Controller water purification system designed for Indian households. It provides multi-stage purification to reduce dissolved impurities, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, and other contaminants while helping retain essential minerals for better-tasting drinking water.
features: Advanced RO + UV + UF Purification – Multi-stage purification helps reduce dissolved solids, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, and impurities.
TDS Controller – Helps adjust the taste of purified water according to the input water quality.
10-Litre Storage Tank – Provides a convenient supply of purified water, including during power interruptions.
15 LPH Purification Capacity – Suitable for regular household drinking-water requirements.
Mineral Retention – Helps retain essential minerals while providing purified drinking water.
Smart Filter Change Indicator – Provides a timely reminder for filter replacement.
